title: ArcGIS Feature Layer Exporter (No 2,000-Row Cap)
description: Export every row of any public ArcGIS FeatureServer or MapServer layer (city, county and state open-data portals) with a SQL where clause, field list and order. Pages past maxRecordCount, converts dates to ISO and geometry to WGS84.
why: ArcGIS returns at most maxRecordCount rows (often 1,000 or 2,000) per query and only says so in a flag most scripts ignore, so exports silently stop. This pages with resultOffset until the layer is exhausted.
useCases: Analysts pulling permits, parcels, crashes or inspections from any Hub/ArcGIS portal
Developers who need a one-shot CSV/JSON of a layer
AI agents that need rows, not a map

includeGeometry.title: Include geometry
includeGeometry.description: Points as latitude/longitude; polygons as rings in WGS84.
